capabilities: extract embedded images and videos from the active note
scroll the gallery and document in sync via two-way linking
open a full-screen zoom modal on double-click
copy, reveal, or delete media with automatic markdown cleanup
switch between six gallery layouts such as masonry and filmstrip
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide media library; it only shows media embedded in the currently active markdown document.
extras: Manual installation from a GitHub release is described; the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff and the README contains a placeholder asking the author to insert their donation link.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated view to see and jump between the media embedded in the note currently being edited.
summary: Media gallery pane that collects all images and videos embedded in the active note and shows them in a customizable sidebar.
